curation.lead:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company incorporated in Delaware in April 2017 and headquartered in Costa Mesa, California [Finding #4565]. Co-founded by Palmer Luckey, the creator of the Oculus VR headset, and Trae Stephens, a Founders Fund partner and former Palantir employee who led the Department of Defense transition team for the first Trump administration, the company has grown from $10 million in revenue during its first twenty months to approximately $2 billion in 2025 [Finding #4670] [Finding #4734]. Anduril has accumulated $2.32 billion in total federal contract obligations, led by the Department of Defense at $1.43 billion and DHS at $862 million [Finding #4960].

The company occupies a distinctive position in the defense industrial base as the primary vehicle through which Peter Thiel's venture capital network intersects with Pentagon procurement. Founders Fund led Anduril's $2.5 billion Series G round in June 2025 with a $1 billion check — the largest single investment in the fund's history — valuing the company at $30.5 billion [Finding #4587]. Anduril is now a frontrunner for the Golden Dome missile defense program alongside consortium partners SpaceX and Palantir, all three of which share Founders Fund as an investor [Finding #4569]. Multiple former Anduril employees now hold senior positions in the agencies that oversee Anduril's contracts, including the Under Secretary of the Army and the DHS Chief Information Officer [Finding #5237] [Finding #5211].

As of early 2026, Anduril's valuation has risen to an estimated $60-91 billion, and the company is reportedly discussing a new funding round at $60 billion or above, with a possible IPO in 2026 [Finding #4734]. Its product portfolio spans autonomous air vehicles (Fury, Altius, Roadrunner), underwater systems (Dive-LD), surveillance towers, counter-drone systems, and the Lattice AI command-and-control platform that integrates all hardware into a unified operating picture [Finding #4675]. The Arsenal-1 hyperscale manufacturing facility in Columbus, Ohio — a $1 billion, 5-million-square-foot campus — is set to begin mass production of autonomous weapons systems in July 2026 [Finding #4670].
curation.system_role: Anduril Industries functions as the hardware and autonomous systems arm of the Thiel defense technology network, converting venture capital investment from Founders Fund into Pentagon procurement revenue while building a manufacturing base and personnel pathway that positions the company as both a major defense contractor and a conduit for Silicon Valley personnel into government agencies overseeing its own contracts.

sections.title: Founding, Thiel Network Origins, and Capital Structure
sections.content:
Anduril's origin story is inseparable from Peter Thiel's defense technology ecosystem. Trae Stephens, who worked at Palantir from 2008 to 2014 before joining Founders Fund as a partner, conceived the idea for Anduril at a Founders Fund retreat in 2014 [Finding #4599]. He recruited Palmer Luckey, who had recently departed Facebook following the sale of Oculus VR, and the two incorporated Anduril Industries, Inc. in Delaware on April 20, 2017 [Finding #4565]. The company was registered through Incorporating Services, Ltd. of Dover, Delaware, and assigned LEI 254900CIXLZUXXNYQW57 [Finding #4578].

Anduril has raised $6.26 billion across seven funding rounds [Finding #4670]. The trajectory accelerated sharply: Series F in August 2024 raised $1.5 billion at a $13 billion valuation, followed by the Series G in June 2025 at $2.5 billion and a $30.5 billion valuation. Founders Fund led the Series G with a $1 billion commitment — its largest single investment — while the round attracted 63 investors including Andreessen Horowitz, 8VC, Lux Capital, General Catalyst, Thrive Capital, Sands Capital, Fidelity, and Franklin Venture Partners [Finding #4670] [Finding #4587]. 1789 Capital, the defense-focused fund partnered with Donald Trump Jr., also participated in the Series G, creating a direct Trump family financial interest in Anduril's government contract outcomes [Finding #4733].

SEC EDGAR filings reveal at least twenty special purpose vehicles offering secondary market access to Anduril shares, including SPVs from Dominari, Augurey Ventures, Aurochs Capital, Tomales Bay Capital (Lux Capital), and Greenbird Intelligence Fund [Finding #4574]. Major mutual fund holders include Fidelity, Franklin Strategic Series, BlackRock Science & Technology Trust, and Variable Insurance Products Fund [Finding #4574]. This extensive secondary market indicates that economic exposure to Anduril extends well beyond its direct investor base into the broader institutional investor ecosystem.

sections.title: Federal Contract Portfolio
sections.content:
Anduril's total federal contract obligations stand at $2.32 billion across all agencies, with the Department of Defense accounting for $1.43 billion and DHS for $862 million [Finding #4960]. Contract growth has been explosive: FY2024 obligations reached $456 million (178.7% growth from FY2023's $164 million), FY2025 totaled $563 million, and FY2026 through early March showed $176 million [Finding #4557]. Revenue approximately doubled from $1 billion in 2024 to $2 billion in 2025 [Finding #4734]. The company operates through multiple federal entities — Anduril Industries Inc., Anduril LLC, and Anduril Engineering LLC — all receiving federal funds [Finding #4577].

The most significant single contract is the Army's IVAS (Integrated Visual Augmentation System) program. Microsoft won the original ten-year, $22 billion IVAS production contract in March 2021 for 120,000+ custom HoloLens headsets, but years of delays and performance failures led to a formal contract novation in April 2025 that transferred the entire program to Anduril [Finding #4679]. Palmer Luckey described the transfer as encompassing "employees, hardware, IP, facilities, everything" [Finding #4679]. Tom Keane, a former Microsoft Azure executive who transitioned with the contract, reported that software release cycles were reduced from 180 days to 18 hours [Finding #4679]. In September 2025, the Army awarded $159 million in SBMC (IVAS Next) prototype contracts to Anduril [Finding #4679].

Other key programs include the TITAN deep-sensing system for long-range fires, where Anduril leads hardware design and manufacturing alongside Palantir as prime contractor under a $178.4 million agreement [Finding #4568]. Anduril manufactures ten TITAN vehicles, with prototypes delivered on time in 2025 and a production decision expected FY2026 [Finding #4568]. At DHS, Anduril has $511 million in CBP border surveillance tower contracts, with contract approval authority running through Corey Lewandowski since January 2025 [Finding #5211]. The $94 million Altius 600M-V loitering munitions production contract for the Navy (February 2025) and counter-drone systems for SOCOM and USMC round out the active portfolio [Finding #4557].

sections.title: Golden Dome and the SpaceX-Palantir-Anduril Consortium
sections.content:
Anduril is a member of the consortium alongside SpaceX and Palantir that proposed a satellite-based missile defense architecture for the Golden Dome program, potentially worth up to $175 billion [Finding #4569]. The proposal calls for 400 to 1,000 tracking satellites plus 200 attack satellites equipped with missiles and lasers [Finding #4569]. Anduril received a Space-Based Interceptor prototype contract in November 2025 and was selected for the $151 billion SHIELD IDIQ in December 2025 [Finding #4734]. The company has also partnered with D-Wave and Davidson on quantum optimization for missile defense computations [Finding #4734].

The structural significance of Golden Dome lies in its convergence of financial interests. All three consortium principals — SpaceX, Palantir, and Anduril — are Founders Fund portfolio companies [Finding #6509]. Kenneth Howery, Founders Fund co-founder and current Ambassador to Denmark, oversees Greenland infrastructure including the Pituffik Space Base, whose AN/FPS-132 radar is critical to Golden Dome's tracking architecture [Finding #5663]. Yet Howery's ethics agreement, which requires recusal from matters affecting SpaceX and Founders Fund IV Principals Fund, does not list Anduril at all — despite Founders Fund's $1 billion investment [Finding #5682]. This gap means Howery could participate in Pituffik infrastructure decisions that directly benefit Anduril's Golden Dome bid without formal recusal obligations, a concern identified by analysis of his ethics disclosures [Finding #5682].

1789 Capital, the fund partnered with Donald Trump Jr., holds positions in both SpaceX and Anduril, creating a direct financial interest for the president's family in the outcome of a program the president announced [Finding #6509]. The systemic analysis identifies Golden Dome as the convergence point where every identified capture stream — SpaceX subscriptions, Palantir C2 platforms, Anduril autonomous systems, and Thiel network financial exposure — meets in a single procurement [Finding #6509].

sections.title: Revolving Door and Government Personnel
sections.content:
Anduril's leadership draws extensively from the national security establishment. Christian Brose, promoted to President and Chief Strategy Officer in January 2025, served as Staff Director of the Senate Armed Services Committee for three years under Senator John McCain and is the author of The Kill Chain [Finding #4576]. Gregory Kausner, a senior vice president, is a former DOD official. Megan Milam serves as a registered federal lobbyist [Finding #4576]. This recruitment pattern from congressional defense committees and the Pentagon creates institutional knowledge and relationship capital that facilitates procurement access [Finding #4576].

The pipeline also flows in the opposite direction. Michael Obadal, former Anduril Senior Director (January 2023 to present per his disclosure), now serves as Under Secretary of the Army — the position overseeing Army acquisition and modernization programs that include Anduril contracts [Finding #5237]. His financial disclosures show $10-50 million in Anduril vested and unvested RSUs, with the Anduril equity alone exceeding his stated net worth range [Finding #5217]. Senator Elizabeth Warren sent a letter to the Office of Government Ethics raising concerns about Obadal's failure to divest, noting that Anduril holds the $22 billion IVAS contract from the Army [Finding #5051]. Ethics lawyer Richard Painter called it "unheard of for a presidential appointee in the Defense Department to retain a financial interest in a defense contractor" [Finding #4584].

Antoine McCord, DHS Chief Information Officer, holds $100-250 million in Anduril stock plus $5-25 million in stock options and RSUs [Finding #5211]. As CIO, McCord oversees DHS technology infrastructure and IT procurement for the agency that has awarded Anduril $862 million in contracts [Finding #5211]. Ryan Wunderly, an Anduril software engineer from 2020 to 2025, now serves as Special Advisor in the Office of the Secretary at Treasury, retaining Anduril stock options and equity valued at $100-250 million [Finding #5241]. Gregory Barbaccia, the Federal CIO at OMB and a ten-year Palantir veteran, held a $100-250 thousand Anduril stake through a VC fund before reportedly divesting in March 2025 [Finding #5100]. This concentration of Anduril equity holders across DHS, Army, Treasury, and OMB is without precedent for a single defense contractor.

sections.title: Lobbying and Political Strategy
sections.content:
Anduril registered its first lobbying activity in September 2017 — the same month as its founding — through Invariant LLC, the firm led by Heather Podesta [Finding #4567]. Initial quarterly spending of $20,000 focused on homeland security issues, growing to $110,000 per quarter by 2020, for a total of $1.24 million tracked through Invariant alone during 2017-2020 [Finding #4997]. By Q4 2020, the lobbying operation expanded to include Thorn Run Partners, Cornerstone Government Affairs, and an in-house registration under Megan Milam [Finding #4567]. Total disclosed lobbying through the LDA filings reached $7.95 million across 100 filings from 2017 through 2024 [Finding #5079].

The political donation landscape reveals a deliberate bipartisan architecture that may be unique among defense technology companies. Founder Palmer Luckey has donated $921,000, with 81% flowing to Republican recipients including $250,000 to the Republican National Committee [Finding #5406]. CEO Brian Schimpf, by contrast, donated $245,000 — 100% to Democratic recipients through ActBlue and candidates including Pat Ryan, Alex Padilla, and Alexander Vindman [Finding #5406]. This CEO-versus-founder split ensures that Anduril maintains relationships regardless of which party controls Congress or the White House, a pattern identified as potentially deliberate in FEC analysis [Finding #5406].

Anduril and Scale AI share Cornerstone Government Affairs and Mehlman Consulting as lobbying firms, with 21 individual lobbyists working for both companies [Finding #5080]. The Anduril PAC receives contributions from senior employees with government backgrounds: Chris Brose (former SASC staff director), Gregory Kausner (former DOD official), and Megan Milam (registered lobbyist) [Finding #4566]. Anduril's total lobbying spend of $7.95 million places it as the largest spender among new-generation defense technology companies, ahead of Shield AI ($6.85 million) and Palantir ($4.29 million tracked during the same period) [Finding #5079].

sections.title: Autonomous Weapons Portfolio and Manufacturing
sections.content:
Anduril's product line spans air, land, sea, undersea, space, and command-and-control domains, all unified through the Lattice AI software platform [Finding #4675]. The Fury (YFQ-44), one of two winning designs for the Air Force's Collaborative Combat Aircraft program, has demonstrated fully autonomous flight matching F-16 maneuver performance and earned a "Fighter" designation [Finding #4675]. In March 2026, the Fury tested mid-flight switching between Shield AI's Hivemind and Anduril's Lattice autonomy stacks — a demonstration of interoperable autonomous fighter control [Finding #4675]. The Air Force may acquire approximately 1,000 CCA aircraft, pairing two autonomous systems per advanced crewed fighter [Finding #4675].

The Roadrunner, a six-foot, twin-turbojet reusable interceptor operating at high subsonic speeds, occupies the space between drone and reusable missile [Finding #4675]. The Altius family includes loitering munitions with ranges up to 620 miles and 15-hour endurance, with the Navy awarding a $94 million Altius 600M-V production contract in February 2025 [Finding #4557] [Finding #4675]. Other systems include Ghost autonomous reconnaissance helicopters, Anvil kinetic counter-UAS drones, Dive-LD autonomous underwater vehicles, and Sentry Tower solar-powered surveillance installations [Finding #4675]. Anduril's Lattice software coordinated autonomous drone swarms in Iran during Operation Epic Fury, validating Fury, Roadrunner, and Barracuda as combat-ready systems.

Arsenal-1, announced January 2025, represents Anduril's bid to become a mass manufacturer of autonomous weapons. Located near Rickenbacker Airport in Pickaway County, Ohio (roughly 16 miles southeast of Columbus), the $1 billion facility will span 5 million square feet on 500 acres and produce tens of thousands of military systems annually [Finding #4670]. It is described as the largest job-creation project in Ohio history, generating 4,000 direct and 4,500 indirect jobs [Finding #4670]. Initial production of Fury, Roadrunner, and Barracuda autonomous air systems is scheduled to begin July 2026 [Finding #4670].

sections.title: International Presence and Corporate Structure
sections.content:
Anduril Industries UK Ltd. (company number 12316056) was incorporated on November 14, 2019, with its registered address at 2 New Street Square, London — the offices of Freshfields Bruckhaus Deringer [Finding #4932]. Current directors include Matthew Marley Grimm (American, appointed at incorporation, listed at 1400 Anduril, Costa Mesa, CA), Richard Daniel Drake (British, appointed 2024), and Maury David Shenk (British, appointed 2024) [Finding #4932]. No persons with significant control are listed on the UK filing [Finding #4932].

Palmer Luckey was sanctioned by China in December 2025 alongside nine other U.S. defense executives and twenty companies over Taiwan arms sales [Finding #4570]. In February 2026, Luckey conducted a secret two-day visit to Israel, meeting Prime Minister Netanyahu and senior defense officials [Finding #4571]. These international engagements position Anduril within the Five Eyes and broader allied defense technology marketplace. Anduril has no FARA registrations, confirming it does not act as a foreign agent [Finding #4578]. Luckey is also co-founder of Erebor Bank in Columbus, Ohio, alongside Joe Lonsdale of 8VC and Palantir, backed by Peter Thiel — a financial institution positioned to serve the defense and technology ecosystem [Finding #4753].
